latest_features: SchemBuild now has a configurable player-anchor fallback and more tolerant armor-stand detection so ghost blocks keep rendering even when Nukkit-style anchor lookup is flaky
ShulkDub no longer runs a crash-prone always-on craft loop on enable and now supports Auto Open, Inventory Entry, and Background trigger modes
ShulkDub's right-side inventory panel now includes a third DUB button for manually firing the shulker craft packet alongside EJECT and KILL
